🔵 BITCOIN
BTC trades at $71918, testing critical $72K resistance with bullish structure intact after breaking above descending channel. Immediate support holds at $69K with momentum targeting $75K if volume sustains. Primary catalyst: ETF inflow data showing consecutive weeks of net accumulation signaling institutional conviction returning to the asset class.
🔷 ETHEREUM
ETH at $2288 underperforming BTC by 2.20% in 24h but dominating weekly timeframe with +21.67% gains. ETH/BTC ratio compression easing as Layer-2 scaling solutions and staking yields revive DeFi capital rotation into the ecosystem.
🚀 TOP ALT
